name: Tourist / Entry Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Law No. 23/2022 requires a valid passport (minimum 6 months' validity) and an entry visa for most nationalities (some waived under bilateral agreements). Applicants must demonstrate 'meios de subsistência' -- means of subsistence for food, accommodation, and return travel -- or provide a sponsor's signed responsibility declaration in lieu of proving personal funds. Mozambique launched a redesigned e-visa/ETA digital application platform in 2026; this dataset could not confirm the exact processing fees or turnaround time against a government tariff schedule.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for an entry visa (or confirm visa-waiver eligibility) via the e-visa portal or a consulate, with proof of funds or a sponsor's responsibility declaration.

evidence_required.document: Proof of means of subsistence, or a sponsor's responsibility declaration

outcome.duration_length: not confirmed against a government validity schedule in this build
